_doc: Per-world launch rules, keyed by Store id (data/fwa.md slug). gen-store.py copies each rule into store.json as launch_query; Galaxy appends it to the world's address (Store.launchUrl). Declared here, never spelled in Kotlin. An optional cpu_query (launch_query_cpu) replaces it when Galaxy falls back to the CPU presentation (#1657: the WebView did not bring the world to the screen). A rule with "off": true stays declared with its why but is not applied: the world loads its plain address. An optional grace_s (0..600) is how long the render check treats a flat world as still loading (store.json render_grace_s), declared for heavy worlds.

floor796.off_why: #1694 off: Cloud-Browser loads the plain address (the default canvas engine) and renders floor796 on the same phone; ?old-render made Galaxy load a different engine whose MP4 tiles the WebView aborts and re-requests with new Range offsets (reported as net::ERR_FAILED, not served by the pinned copy: static.floor796.com is not the pinned host) and the scene stayed empty. Galaxy now loads exactly what Cloud-Browser loads. Set off to false to bring the video-tile engine back.
floor796.why: The default engine downloads a 175 MB F796 file into a worker (held twice in memory, plus a Cache API write) and stays blank when the WebView renderer cannot hold it. ?old-render selects the legacy engine, which streams the 127 MB MP4 tiles for the viewport only. Remove this rule to get the best-quality engine back.
floor796.cpu_why: The legacy engine is video tiles, which only the GPU presents. In the CPU presentation (CPU-backed 2D canvases) the default canvas engine is loaded instead, so the scene is drawn as a bitmap the WebView presents like any image.
floor796.grace_why: #1694 the default engine loads a 175 MB scene file before it creates its canvas (0x0 until then), which takes longer than the 20 s default on a slow link or an emulator; the render check called it 'not rendering' and reloaded it in the CPU presentation, which restarted the download. Cloud-Browser (no render check) shows the scene. The check now waits this long for floor796.
